items.exampleEn: The fishermen leave the harbor at dawn.
The coffee machine heats the water almost instantly.
items.exampleZh: 這台咖啡機幾乎一瞬間就能把水加熱。

items.exampleEn: Mr. Lin was formerly the head of our sales team.
items.exampleZh: 林先生以前是我們業務團隊的主管。

items.exampleEn: Their enduring friendship began in high school.
items.exampleZh: 他們長久的友誼從高中就開始了。

items.exampleEn: Details of the forthcoming event will be sent next week.
items.exampleZh: 即將舉行的活動細節下週會寄出。

items.exampleEn: Whenever I visit, my aunt invariably offers me tea.
items.exampleZh: 每次我去拜訪，阿姨總是會請我喝茶。

items.exampleEn: The train left ten minutes before its scheduled time.
items.exampleZh: 火車比預定時間早十分鐘開走了。

items.exampleEn: Many of these simple recipes come from wartime, when food was hard to find.
items.exampleZh: 這些簡單的食譜很多來自戰時，那時食物很難取得。

items.sentenceEn: The forthcoming meeting will be held in the main hall.
items.sentenceZh: 即將召開的會議將在大廳舉行。

items.audioEn: The bus is scheduled to leave at seven, but it invariably leaves late.
items.audioZh: 這班公車預定七點出發，但它總是遲到。
items.questionZh: 關於這班公車，說話者說了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: She formerly lived in Tainan, but she moved here last year.
items.sentenceZh: 她以前住在台南，但去年搬來這裡。

items.sentenceEn: The soup was so good that I instantly asked for another bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 湯好喝到我馬上又要了一碗。

items.stemEn: Jason loves routine; whenever we eat out, he ____ orders the same dish.
items.stemZh: Jason 喜歡固定的習慣；每次我們出去吃飯，他總是點同一道菜。

items.stemEn: We got up before ____ to watch the sunrise from the mountain.
items.stemZh: 我們在黎明前起床，要從山上看日出。

items.passageEn: Every year, the town of Lukang holds a festival of lights. The festival has become an enduring tradition, and many local families come back to it every year. The old town square, formerly a busy market, is the center of the event. This year's festival is scheduled for this coming weekend, and the forthcoming program includes music and dance. Visitors invariably arrive early to find a good spot, and some even wait from dawn. When thousands of lights are turned on at seven, the whole square instantly turns bright and warm. Admittedly, the square gets very crowded, but many visitors say it is the most beautiful night of the year.
items.passageZh: 鹿港每年都會舉辦燈會。這個節慶已成為歷久不衰的傳統，很多在地家庭每年都會回來參加。老城廣場以前是熱鬧的市場，現在是活動的中心。今年的燈會預定在這個週末舉行，即將推出的節目包括音樂和舞蹈。遊客總是很早就到，想找個好位置，有些人甚至從黎明就開始等。晚上七點，成千上萬盞燈一點亮，整個廣場立刻變得明亮又溫暖。不可否認，廣場會非常擁擠，但很多遊客說那是一年中最美的夜晚。

options: 以前是港口的河邊老碼頭
火車站前面的大型停車場
以前是市場的老城廣場

questions.questionZh: 為什麼有些遊客從黎明就開始等？

items.promptZh: 會議預定今天下午三點開始。
referenceEn: The meeting is scheduled to start at three this afternoon.
The meeting is scheduled for three o'clock this afternoon.
rubricZh: be scheduled to＋動詞（例如 is scheduled to start）或 be scheduled for＋時間都可以
「下午三點」可寫 three this afternoon、3 p.m. 等

items.promptZh: 這家麵包店的麵包總是在中午前就賣光了。
referenceEn: The bread at this bakery is invariably sold out before noon.
This bakery invariably sells out of bread before noon.
rubricZh: invariably 表示「總是、一向」，可放 be 動詞後或一般動詞前（例如 is invariably sold out 等）
「賣光」可寫，例如 is sold out、sells out of、is all gone 等
「中午前」可寫，例如 before noon、by noon、before lunchtime 等
